text.text: IBM® Storwize® V7000 and Storwize V7000F are powerful storage systems designed to enable rapid deployment without additional resources, while providing: High performance: Capitalize on all-flash configuration to maximize speed or select hybrid storage performance Virtualization: Accommodate growing capacity needs while controlling the storage footprint. Extend virtualization across additional storage systems to enhance utilization Scalability: Scale the system and create a clustered environment to allow growth while leveraging existing storage investments. Ease of use: Help simplify management with an intuitive graphical user interface (GUI). Efficiency: Reduce your future storage needs by storing a higher volume of data on the same physical drive than data that is not compressed

graphic.text:
IBM® Storwize® V7000 and Storwize V7000F are powerful storage systems designed to enable rapid deployment without additional resources, while providing:

High performance: Capitalize on all-flash configuration to maximize speed or select hybrid storage performance

Virtualization: Accommodate growing capacity needs while controlling the storage footprint. Extend virtualization across additional storage systems to enhance utilization

Scalability: Scale the system and create a clustered environment to allow growth while leveraging existing storage investments.

Ease of use: Help simplify management with an intuitive graphical user interface (GUI).

Efficiency: Reduce your future storage needs by storing a higher volume of data on the same physical drive than data that is not compressed

text.text: Virtualize added IBM and non-IBM storage. Integrate systems into the IBM® Storwize® environment to capitalize on capabilities, from advanced replication and thin provisioning to the IBM Real-time Compression™ option and IBM Easy Tier® migration. Enhance administrative efficiency, utilization and current investments.

text.text: Speed time to value, help reduce cost and sustain productivity with nondisruptive migrations. Maintain user access to data while migrating data from another system to IBM® Storwize® storage. Replace legacy storage, move data to a tiered storage infrastructure or conduct load balancing without downtime.

Replicate between any IBM® Storwize® storage offerings with Fibre Channel, Ethernet or Fibre Channel over Ethernet (FCoE). Innovative IP replication optimizes network bandwidth.

text.text: Protect, share and move data using IBM® HyperSwap® topology, which enables a single model of Storwize V7000 or V7000F to support servers in two data centers. Benefit from a completely redundant storage infrastructure. Avoid disruption and eliminate downtime costs. HyperSwap provides continuous data access with no performance impact.

text.text: Using Easy Tier technology, you can deploy solid-state drives (SSDs) confidently, effectively and economically by automatically and dynamically moving only the appropriate data to the SSDs in the system, based on ongoing performance monitoring. Such effective storage tiering enables users to enjoy the performance benefits of SSDs without requiring administrators to create and manage storage tier policies – and without the excessive costs associated with placing too much of the wrong data on these relatively expensive drives. Easy Tier can deliver up to 200 throughput improvement while also reducing application response time.
